cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You don't think they let me win the race, do you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Because they couldn't maintain my pace.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One of them stopped to tie a shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then acknowledge my superior knot preparation.

mechanism: A recruits its former running pupil to interpret rival slowing and a shoe stop as proof A preparation deserved the race win.
confusable: Not denying rival mishaps: A converts each mishap into a comparison of preparation that warrants credit to A.
comparison: Learned quiz knowledge versus race pacing and secured laces.
